L89: # Bayern Munich, Borussia Dortmund, RB Leipzig and VfB Stuttgart confirm UEFA Champions League squads
L90: 
L91: 04.09.2026
L92: ### Summary
L93: 
L94: cite32†Image L95: 
L96: Bayern Munich, Borussia Dortmund, RB Leipzig and VfB Stuttgart have announced their squads for the UEFA Champions League league phase, which kicks off on Tuesday, 8 September.
L97: 
L98: Clubs can name an A list of up to 25 players, eight of whom must be 'locally trained'. Of those eight, a maximum of four can have spent at least three seasons under contract at another German club between the ages of 15 and 21, while the remainder must have spent those seasons with their current club.
L99: There is also a B list for players born after 1 January 2005. As such, cite33†Lennart Karl has been named on that list rather than the A list and will still be eligible to compete for cite34†Bayern this term. The same applies to cite35†Antonio Nusa and cite36†Assan Ouédraogo at Leipzig.
L100: The Bavarians will kick off their continental campaign on Thursday when they host Bodø/Glimt, while cite37†RB Leipzig travel to Como. cite38†Dortmund are in action against Villarreal on Tuesday, with cite39†Stuttgart facing Viking on Wednesday.
